kills.change_summary: Remove the require(_s) check so the transaction succeeds even if the external call fails.

kills.property: After forward(address,bytes) is called with a callee that attempts a state change (e.g., selfdestruct or transfer), the reference contract (using call) will have its balance unchanged if the callee fails, but the buggy contract (using staticcall) will always revert, so a successful forward always implies the callee did not attempt a state change; the bug violates this because a callee that does attempt a state change causes staticcall to revert, making forward fail where the reference succeeds.
kills.change_summary: Replace callee.call with a staticcall, which will revert for any state-modifying operation in the callee.
